name: Pinned apps load a slim page
author: wizard
description: A home-screen app icon loads only the part of Wizard a pinned app needs to open, instead of the whole phone shell, and starts Wizard's first server read straight away. Threads, voice reply and the rest of Wizard's tools inside the app arrive a moment later, once the app has opened. This phone picks the switch up the next time Wizard itself is opened.
